title: quercus rubra var. ambigua
intro: Quercus rubra var. ambigua, commonly known as the Cooley's Red Oak, is a variant of the Red Oak tree (Quercus rubra) that is native to North America. This deciduous tree is valued for its rich history of traditional medicinal use, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cooley's Red Oak include wound healing, soothing digestive issues, and reducing fever. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
